item: Local modal transient of the Analytic model
why: Vias and heatsinks stay local in a coupled modal block of the lowest 16 x 16 modes with one factor on the via couplings fitted to the steady solve, instead of the smeared one-sided calibration; the time to 63 % of the boards with vias or a heatsink moves (example_board and profile_board also carry the per-layer edge of the steady model).
